scope: engineering prototype; functional traditional and hybrid suites, plus device/key lifecycle, rekey, secure reconnect and a dynamic multi-device gateway; NOT audited and NOT post-quantum-secure
readiness_reason: G1/G2/G3 corrected source; status is determined only by results/m5b_corrected_readiness.json and current raw logs, not historical closure prose.

cancellation.problem: Send/Receive checked ctx once before taking a sync.Mutex and never again; a blocked read, a blocked write and a queued sender were all uninterruptible
cancellation.fix: cancellable semaphore replaces the mutex; in-flight I/O is interrupted by expiring the direction's deadline; a waiter cancelled before it starts does not send

handshake_budget.problem: frameIO reset time.Now().Add(timeout) on every frame, so the caller's handshake deadline did not bound the network operations
handshake_budget.fix: one absolute deadline for H1..H4: the earlier of the caller's deadline and the local budget; never renewed

handshake_scope_leak.problem: a handshake-scoped context could in principle outlive the handshake
handshake_scope_leak.fix: the handshake installs no connection watcher; per-operation watchers are stopped and invalidated by generation, so a late callback cannot expire a later operation's deadline

frame_eof.problem: a fully read length prefix with the body missing returned io.EOF, so a peer that died mid-frame was reported as a clean close
frame_eof.fix: wire.ErrTruncated (wrapping io.ErrUnexpectedEOF); only 'no byte of the next frame' is a clean close

summarizer.problem: empty, garbage and truncated input all exited 0; a failure with no fail event could be reported as a pass
summarizer.fix: non-empty, strict JSON, field types, lifecycle closure, expected package set and the real go exit code are all required; exit 2 = unusable evidence, exit 1 = failed run

e2e_and_evidence.problem: acceptance used grep/sed counts on one endpoint only; session_id was truncated to 8 bytes; a failed run could leave a stale PASS; per-endpoint channel state was collapsed into one false; DeliveredPlaintext was written as a constant true
e2e_and_evidence.fix: shared strict verifier for shell and PowerShell; full 32-hex session id plus a separate short display field; per-run directories with RUNNING/PASS/FAIL/INTERRUPTED; per-endpoint channel flags; counters from actual observation with null for unobserved

line_endings.problem: scripts/m2-e2e.sh shipped with CRLF; bash -n on Linux exited 2
line_endings.fix: all text files normalised to LF; .gitattributes pins it; no global Git setting is changed

run_correlation.problem: events carried no run identifier, so a log could not be tied to one run except by file modification time
run_correlation.fix: gateway/device accept -run-id and stamp every event; the e2e harness generates one per run

preserved: real SM2 signatures and the full SM2 key exchange (SM2MQV + SM2SharedKey), not plain ECDH
all identity, key-id, role, signature and Finished checks
real SM4-GCM records (never an AES stand-in)
sequence numbers never rolled back, sender never rebuilt with an old key
no post-quantum claim: suite 2 mixes SM2 and ML-KEM-768 secrets, but SM2 identity authentication is not post-quantum
the default minimum_mode remains hybrid; Suite 2 is implemented and no automatic hybrid-to-traditional fallback is allowed
cmd/bench implements smoke measurements only; the formal 1000-trial mode remains locked until M5B/M5 formal validation
verification_gaps: race detector NOT executed: -race cannot run on this machine (the MinGW import library requests __iob_func, which the system msvcrt.dll does not export). An environment block is NOT evidence that the project has no races.
SM2 key agreement has no independent implementation cross-check (OpenSSL exposes no SM2MQV on the command line)
no formal analysis, no external audit, no compliance certification
recorded_limitations: reuse of an ML-KEM encapsulation key across sessions is not detectable by the responder; only degenerate cases such as all-zero are caught
the control message only updates a parameter value; no timer drives periodic sampling at that interval
a repeated operation_id with different parameters returns Duplicate=true and does not change the applied value (pinned contract)
exactly-once delivery across process restarts is NOT IMPLEMENTED and no database was introduced
suite 2 does not make the system post-quantum: SM2 identity authentication is not post-quantum
key destruction is best effort, not secure erasure
not_claimed: a security audit or compliance certification
a post-quantum or hybrid secure channel
that a passing Finished check means the peer's public key was honestly generated
that the absence of a race-detector run means there are no data races

suite_2_hybrid.ikm: E("edgehybrid/v1/ikm", u16(2), "sm2", Zsm2, "mlkem768", Zpq) — real, dual dependency

suite_2_open_conditions: implicit rejection is caught by Finished

m3_fixes.hybrid_handshake: H1 carries a per-handshake ML-KEM-768 ekA; H2 carries a real kem_ct that SigB authenticates; the device really decapsulates; the IKM depends on both secrets
m3_fixes.negotiation_rules: advertising suite 2 and selecting suite 2 are separate; ekA follows the offer, kem_ct follows the selection; an H1 that advertised hybrid but ends on suite 1 still keeps its offer and ekA in the transcript
m3_fixes.downgrade_resistance: client recomputes the expected suite; the capability list and kem_ct are inside the transcript; 9 wire-level scenarios rejected, 3 of them at the signature stage
m3_fixes.implicit_rejection: same-length tampered ciphertext produces a different Zpq with no error; caught at finished_confirmation with identical transcripts
m3_fixes.no_auto_fallback: a failed hybrid handshake ends the connection; exactly one ClientHello is sent
m3_fixes.traditional_contract: ikm for suite 1 now REJECTS a PQ secret instead of ignoring it

dynamic_device_set.state: map[device_id]*SessionState, per-device keys, SID, record state, revocation and lifecycle

lifecycle.rotation_policy: atomic replacement (no dual-key window), requires new key ids AND new public keys
lifecycle.revocation_observed_by: reload before every handshake + periodic sweep (250ms)

rekey.freshness: new SID, new record keys, new nonce prefixes, seq restarts at 0

m4.production_test_hooks: none - fault injection only via Config.KEM in _test.go files

validator_fixes: strict one-object JSON with duplicate/trailing-data rejection
evidence_finalization_fixes: stop/wait event producers before event-file close
validation.json write errors are fatal to validation
